note: Every controlled vocabulary the company profile schema draws from. Vocabularies shared with the canonical organization model (confidence, sourceType, scaleBasis) are deliberately reused rather than redefined, so one vocabulary exists per concept.

entityTypes.label: Private Company (Pty) Ltd
entityTypes.note: The dominant registered form. CIPC registration number format YYYY/NNNNNN/07.

entityTypes.label: Public Company Ltd
entityTypes.note: Registration number format YYYY/NNNNNN/06. Almost all JSE-listed companies use this form.

entityTypes.label: Personal Liability Company (Inc)
entityTypes.note: Used by attorneys, doctors, accountants and other professions; directors carry joint liability.

entityTypes.label: Non-Profit Company (NPC)
entityTypes.note: Registration number format YYYY/NNNNNN/08. May additionally hold NPO Act registration with the Department of Social Development.

entityTypes.label: Close Corporation (CC)
entityTypes.note: Legacy form. No new close corporations may be registered since the Companies Act of 2008 took effect, but thousands remain on the register and still trade. Registration number format YY/NNNNNN/23.

entityTypes.label: Sole Proprietorship
entityTypes.note: No separate legal personality and no CIPC registration number. Identified for tax purposes by the owner's income tax number.

entityTypes.label: Partnership
entityTypes.note: Common in professional practices and farming operations; not separately registered with CIPC.

entityTypes.label: Trust
entityTypes.note: Registered with the Master of the High Court (IT number). Common for community trusts, family businesses and farming structures.

entityTypes.label: Co-operative
entityTypes.note: Registered under the Co-operatives Act; registration number format YYYY/NNNNNN/24. Includes primary, secondary and agricultural co-operatives.

entityTypes.label: State-Owned Company (SOC) Ltd
entityTypes.note: State-owned companies defined in the Companies Act and governed by the PFMA. Registration number format YYYY/NNNNNN/30.

entityTypes.label: Public Entity
entityTypes.note: PFMA Schedule 2 or 3 entities, including national regulators and agencies.

entityTypes.label: Municipal Entity
entityTypes.note: Governed by the MFMA and the Municipal Systems Act; may be a private company, trust or municipal service utility.

entityTypes.label: National or Provincial Department
entityTypes.note: Not a registered juristic person; identified by vote and department code.

entityTypes.label: Voluntary Association (NPO Act)
entityTypes.note: Registered with the Department of Social Development under the NPO Act without CIPC incorporation.

entityTypes.label: External Company / Foreign Branch
entityTypes.note: Foreign company registered as an external company with CIPC; registration number format YYYY/NNNNNN/10.

entityTypes.label: Unregistered Informal Enterprise
entityTypes.note: No CIPC registration. Essential to the taxonomy: spaza shops, street traders, taxi operators and stokvels largely sit here. Identity is carried by trading name, location and tax status instead of a registration number.

cipcStatuses.label: Registered - active
cipcStatuses.note: Company exists on the register and annual returns are current.

cipcStatuses.label: Registered - annual returns in arrears
cipcStatuses.note: The single most common defect in South African company data. A company can trade perfectly well while its annual returns are years overdue; do not infer insolvency from this status.

cipcStatuses.label: Deregistered
cipcStatuses.note: Removed from the register, usually for non-filing of annual returns. Frequently reversible on application.

cipcStatuses.label: Final deregistration
cipcStatuses.note: Deregistration completed; the juristic person no longer exists.

cipcStatuses.label: Provisional liquidation
cipcStatuses.note: Court order granted, not yet final.

cipcStatuses.label: Business rescue
cipcStatuses.note: Practitioner appointed under Chapter 6 of the Companies Act; the company continues to trade.

cipcStatuses.label: Under review / name reserved
cipcStatuses.note: Name reservation or incorporation in progress.

cipcStatuses.label: Unknown - not yet verified
cipcStatuses.note: Distinct from a verified absence of status. Rendered as unknown, never as a clean status.

taxComplianceStatuses.label: Tax Compliance Status - valid PIN
taxComplianceStatuses.note: SARS TCS PIN issued and verifiable in real time by third parties.

taxComplianceStatuses.label: TCS applied, PIN not yet issued
Non-compliant - returns outstanding or debt owed
VAT vendor registered
taxComplianceStatuses.note: Recorded alongside income tax status; mandatory above the R1m compulsory threshold and voluntary below it.

taxComplianceStatuses.label: Turnover tax registered
taxComplianceStatuses.note: Small business tax regime for qualifying micro enterprises.

coidaStatuses.label: Compensation Fund registered - Letter of Good Standing valid
Registered - Letter of Good Standing expired
Registered - returns or payments not current
Not registered with the Compensation Fund
Exempt or not applicable
coidaStatuses.note: Certain categories of employer fall outside COIDA coverage.

categories.label: Exempted Micro Enterprise (EME)
categories.evidence: Sworn affidavit on the dtic gazetted template before a Commissioner of Oaths, valid 12 months
categories.levelUplift: Level 2 at 51% or more black ownership; Level 1 at 100% black ownership

categories.label: Qualifying Small Enterprise (QSE)
categories.evidence: SANAS-accredited verification, or a sworn affidavit where the QSE is at least 51% black-owned
categories.levelUplift: Level 2 / Level 1 on the affidavit path

categories.label: Generic Enterprise
categories.evidence: Full five-element scorecard verified by a SANAS-accredited agency
categories.levelUplift: None - level is awarded purely on score

categories.label: Start-up Enterprise
categories.evidence: Sworn affidavit for the first 12 months of operation
categories.levelUplift: Treated as an EME for its first year

categories.label: Not verified
categories.evidence: No affidavit or certificate on file

categories.label: Not applicable
categories.note: Public entities, departments and foreign entities outside the Codes' scope

sectorCodes.label: Construction Sector Code
sectorCodes.note: Construction EME threshold is R3m, not the general R10m.

sectorCodes.label: Marketing, Advertising and Communication Sector Code
sectorCodes.note: PR QSE band starts at R5m.

sectorCodes.label: Tourism Sector Code
sectorCodes.note: Tourism uses R5m and R45m rather than the general bands.

sectorCodes.label: Mining Charter
sectorCodes.note: Mineral and Petroleum Resources Development Act ownership and procurement obligations apply in addition to the Codes.

bbbee.sourceNote: EME and QSE turnover boundaries and the sector-code variations were confirmed against published dtic-aligned guidance on 2026-10-08. Sector codes are gazetted independently and change; re-verify before a procurement decision.

localMunicipalityPolicy.reason: Local municipalities (205 of them) are recorded as free text with a source URL and checkedOn date rather than as a hardcoded enumeration, because municipal boundaries are amended by the Municipal Demarcation Board and a stale enumeration silently misassigns every company in the affected area. Metros and district municipalities are stable enough to enumerate; local municipalities must be loaded from the current MDB determination.

regionalEconomicHubs.label: Gauteng Financial Services Corridor

regionalEconomicHubs.label: East Rand Industrial Belt
regionalEconomicHubs.note: Ekurhuleni and the East Rand: automotive components, engineering, packaging and distribution centres.

regionalEconomicHubs.label: Vaal Triangle Steel & Industrial Complex

regionalEconomicHubs.label: Johannesburg Technology & Services Cluster

regionalEconomicHubs.label: Cape Town Technology & BPO Cluster
regionalEconomicHubs.note: Woodstock, Claremont, Century City and the northern suburbs: software studios, fintech and contact centres.

regionalEconomicHubs.label: Cape Winelands & Deciduous Fruit Region
regionalEconomicHubs.note: Wine estates, cellars, deciduous fruit packhouses and agribusiness services.

regionalEconomicHubs.label: Eastern Cape Automotive Cluster
regionalEconomicHubs.note: Gqeberha, East London and the Coega / IDZ corridors: vehicle assembly plants and Tier 1 supplier parks.

regionalEconomicHubs.label: Eastern Cape Wind Corridor
regionalEconomicHubs.note: Wind IPP concentration and associated O&M services.

regionalEconomicHubs.label: Durban Logistics & Port Corridor
regionalEconomicHubs.note: Bayhead, Isipingo, Dube TradePort and the N3 corridor: container cartage, warehousing and clearing.

regionalEconomicHubs.label: KZN North Coast Sugar & Agro-Processing Region
regionalEconomicHubs.note: Sugarcane, mills and associated agro-processing.

regionalEconomicHubs.label: Mpumalanga Coal & Energy Belt
regionalEconomicHubs.note: eMalahleni, Middelburg and Secunda: coal supply, power generation, synthetic fuels and shutdown services.

regionalEconomicHubs.label: Mpumalanga Forestry & Pulp Region
regionalEconomicHubs.note: Plantations, sawmills and pulp and paper operations.

regionalEconomicHubs.label: Free State Chemical & Industrial Corridor
regionalEconomicHubs.note: Sasolburg and the northern Free State: petrochemical, chemical and engineering service firms.

regionalEconomicHubs.label: Maize Triangle
regionalEconomicHubs.note: Grain production, co-operative silos and input supply around Bothaville, Lichtenburg and Bethlehem.

regionalEconomicHubs.label: Rustenburg PGM Belt
regionalEconomicHubs.note: PGM and chrome mining, concentrators, smelters and mining services.

regionalEconomicHubs.label: Limpopo Mining & Waterberg Complex
regionalEconomicHubs.note: Platreef PGM, coal, chrome and mining infrastructure services.

regionalEconomicHubs.label: Limpopo Subtropical Agriculture Region
regionalEconomicHubs.note: Tzaneen and surrounding subtropical fruit, citrus and avocado production.

regionalEconomicHubs.label: Kalahari Iron Ore & Manganese Field
regionalEconomicHubs.note: Sishen and Kolomela ore operations, ore-line rail and Saldanha export logistics.

regionalEconomicHubs.label: Kimberley & West Coast Diamond Region
regionalEconomicHubs.note: Kimberlite and alluvial diamond operations plus marine mining on the West Coast.

regionalEconomicHubs.label: Northern Cape Green Hydrogen Coast
regionalEconomicHubs.note: Boegoebaai and associated renewable export infrastructure.

regionalEconomicHubs.label: Sundays River Citrus Region
regionalEconomicHubs.note: Citrus production and packhouses feeding the Port Elizabeth cold chain.

jseListingStatuses.label: Previously listed, now delisted
jseListingStatuses.note: Record the delisting date and reason; delisting is not a failure state and does not remove the company from Tier 1.

jseListingStatuses.label: Listing status unverified
jseListingStatuses.note: Never render an unverified listing as not-listed.

registrationRegulators.label: Companies and Intellectual Property Commission
registrationRegulators.whatItRegisters: Company, close corporation, external company and NPC registration; annual returns; beneficial ownership

registrationRegulators.label: South African Revenue Service
registrationRegulators.whatItRegisters: Income tax, VAT, PAYE, UIF, SDL registration and the Tax Compliance Status PIN

registrationRegulators.label: Compensation Fund (Department of Employment and Labour)
registrationRegulators.whatItRegisters: COIDA employer registration and the Letter of Good Standing

registrationRegulators.label: National Treasury Central Supplier Database
registrationRegulators.whatItRegisters: Supplier registration for state procurement, linked to tax and bank verification

registrationRegulators.label: Department of Trade, Industry and Competition
registrationRegulators.whatItRegisters: B-BBEE certificates on the national database, EME affidavits, incentives and designations

registrationRegulators.label: South African National Accreditation System
registrationRegulators.whatItRegisters: Accreditation of B-BBEE verification agencies and testing laboratories

registrationRegulators.label: Construction Industry Development Board
registrationRegulators.whatItRegisters: Contractor grading (grades 1-9) by works category

registrationRegulators.label: National Home Builders Registration Council
registrationRegulators.whatItRegisters: Home builder and contractor enrolment for residential construction

registrationRegulators.label: Private Security Industry Regulatory Authority
registrationRegulators.whatItRegisters: Security service providers and officers

registrationRegulators.label: Property Practitioners Regulatory Authority
registrationRegulators.whatItRegisters: Estate agencies and property practitioners

registrationRegulators.label: Financial Sector Conduct Authority
registrationRegulators.whatItRegisters: Financial Services Providers, representatives and key individuals

registrationRegulators.label: South African Reserve Bank / Prudential Authority
registrationRegulators.whatItRegisters: Banks, insurers and prudentially regulated institutions

registrationRegulators.label: Financial Intelligence Centre
registrationRegulators.whatItRegisters: Accountable and reporting institutions under FICA

registrationRegulators.label: National Energy Regulator of South Africa
registrationRegulators.whatItRegisters: Generation, transmission, distribution and petroleum licences

registrationRegulators.label: Independent Communications Authority of South Africa
registrationRegulators.whatItRegisters: Telecommunications licences, spectrum and broadcasting

registrationRegulators.label: South African Health Products Regulatory Authority
registrationRegulators.whatItRegisters: Medicines, medical devices and establishments

registrationRegulators.label: Engineering Council of South Africa
registrationRegulators.whatItRegisters: Professional engineers, technologists and technicians

registrationRegulators.label: South African Council for the Project and Construction Management Professions
registrationRegulators.whatItRegisters: Construction management professionals

registrationRegulators.label: Municipal Demarcation Board
registrationRegulators.whatItRegisters: Municipal boundaries, wards and demarcation determinations

registrationRegulators.label: Small Enterprise Development Agency
registrationRegulators.whatItRegisters: SMME support programme registration

municipalityCodePolicy.reason: Municipal demarcation codes (DC1-DC48, CPT, JHB, ...) are deliberately NOT enumerated in this file. The codes were not verifiable from within this environment and a wrong code silently misroutes every company in that district. Slug ids plus labels plus province are sufficient for the geographic anchor matrix; load codes from the current Municipal Demarcation Board determination when they are needed.
